### Filing-ready paragraphs (the seat files them; re-observed at `main` @ `561b7642`, stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900: rows 2, 3, 4, 13 tab strip, 14 list, 15, 16, 19 and 20. Rows 10, 12 result line, 13 rest, 14 grant message and 22 rest are the walkthrough's readings at `c4c515ad` with the source line confirmed on `main`, not re-driven here)

1. **Row 2 — Settings help text speaks to engineers (server copy).** Who: an administrator in Setup → Settings. What happens: Authentication's help reads `invite_only` / `email_domain` / `open` and `OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`; Feature Flags reads `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED=true`; Mail mentions `sys_email`; the Webhooks subtitle reads `defineStack({ webhooks })` / `defineWebhook()` / "webhook auto-enqueuer"; an inherited value's badge names the layer "Tenant". Where: `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/auth.manifest.ts`, `feature-flags.manifest.ts`, `mail.manifest.ts` and their `translations/*`; the `sourceLabels.tenant` string; `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.object.ts` description. Wanted: business wording in `help`, the technical detail behind a "learn more" (a docs link) rather than in the sentence. Reach: every administrator opening Settings, today. Dedupe words: settings help machine values env var.
2. **Row 3 — Settings sidebar and hub disagree (server nav).** What happens: the sidebar says "Email" (`nav_settings_mail`) where the hub card says "Mail Delivery"; the hub lists SMS Delivery and Data Lifecycle, the sidebar has neither. Where: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` (Configuration group) against the manifests' `title` in `service-settings`. Wanted: one name per settings page and the same set in both. Reach: every administrator. Dedupe words: setup nav settings sidebar hub mismatch.
3. **Row 4 rest — raw machine values in System Overview and Notifications (server metadata).** What happens: the "Audit Events by Action" legend and table show `config_change`, because the `sys_audit_log_metrics` dataset declares `action` as `type: 'string'` (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts`); Notifications shows topic `approval.requested` and source `sys_approval_request` raw (`topic` and `source_object` are `Field.text` in `sys-notification.object.ts`), and `severity` options carry lowercase labels (`Field.select(['info','warning','critical'])`); Users carry "Env-Native" (`sys-user.object.ts` identity-source option). Wanted: labelled dimension values, a topic/object label, title-case option labels. Reach: every administrator on System Overview / Notifications. (The info badge colour is fixed in this PR.)
4. **Row 10, Create User half — "Either email or phoneNumber is required" (server).** What happens: Create User with Email empty answers that sentence (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts`, `badRequest('Either email or phoneNumber is required')`); `phoneNumber` is an API key and the form has no phone field; the dialog shows no required marks because its params are declared optional in `sys-user.object.ts`. Wanted: "Email is required" (or "Email or phone number is required" where phone sign-in is on), and the param marked required when phone sign-in is off. Reach: every administrator creating a user.
5. **Row 12, Create User result — the copy line shows when no password was generated (server).** What happens: after Create User with a typed password, the result still says "If a temporary password was generated, copy it now" (`sys-user.object.ts`, two result texts). Wanted: the line only when the server generated one. Reach: every administrator creating a user with a typed password.
6. **Row 13 rest — the user record hides Locale and ban state (server page metadata).** What happens: Details shows only created/updated, so a saved Locale is invisible; no Banned badge or ban reason; "Platform Role: user" is lowercase. Where: `sys-user.object.ts` (record page sections, highlight fields, role option labels). Wanted: Locale, ban state and reason on Details; a label for the platform role. Reach: every administrator opening a user. (The cut tab strip is fixed in this PR.)
7. **Row 14 — a user's Permission Sets tab shows API names (ui + server).** What happens: the related list shows `organization_admin_no_bypass` / `admin_full_access`: `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` is a by-name text column with `widget: 'permission-ref'`, and no list cell reads a registry label for it. Wanted (ui card, `@object-ui/fields`): a read face for `permission-ref` / `position-ref` cells that draws the registry label with the name on `title`. Wanted (server card): the role change that auto-grants a set says so in its result. Reach: every administrator opening a user.
8. **Row 15 columns — no Status or Role on the Users list (server).** Where: `sys-user.object.ts` list views (`all_users` columns: name, email, phone, email verified, identity source, created). Wanted: Status (banned) and Role columns. Reach: every administrator on Users.
9. **Row 16 rest — New Permission Set puts Name first and stacks three messages.** (a) spec: `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts` orders Name before Label and leaves Label optional; wanted Label first and required.
